title: BroodMinder Weight Hive Weight Leaderboard
dataSources: Beehive telemetry (`beehive:reading`), coop door (`chickencoop:door`), egg counts (`egg:count`), livestock tags (`livestock:tag`), feed level (`feed:level`), pasture sensors (`pasture:sensor`), trail cams (`trailcam:detection`).
app: Homestead sensors — connected beehive scale/temperature/sound, automatic chicken-coop door, egg counter, livestock GPS/health tags, feed-silo level, and pasture soil sensors — via MQTT and LoRaWAN gateways.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=broodminder:weight weight_kg=*
| stats sum(weight_kg) as total_value, avg(weight_kg) as avg_value by hive_id
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks hive values by total and average hive weight across BroodMinder weight events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `weight_kg` values for each BroodMinder weight event and review total and average hive weight by hive.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total hive weight.
grandmaExplanation: It times which hive shows the biggest hive weight numbers in your BroodMinder weight data.
